sanskrit: ekaśataṃ viṣkandhāni viṣṭhitā pṛthivīm anu | teṣāṃ tu sarveṣām idam astu viṣkandhadūṣaṇam ||
english: One hundred and one viṣkandhas are spread throughout the earth. Of all of them, let this be the viṣkandha-nullifier.

sanskrit: karṣaphasya viśaphasya dyauṣpitā pṛthivī mātā | yathābhicakra devās tathāpi kṛṇutā punaḥ ||
english: Of Karṣapha, of Viśapha — Dyauṣpitā (Sky-Father) is the father, Earth the mother. Just as the gods have acted against them, so act ye against them again likewise.

sanskrit: aśleṣmāṇo adhārayan tathā tan manunā kṛtam | kṛṇomi vadhri viṣkandhaṃ muṣkābarho gavām iva ||
english: The sputum-free ones (the seers) upheld it; thus was it made by Manu. I render the viṣkandha castrate (vadhri), even as one strips the scrotum from the bulls of the herd.

sanskrit: sūtre piśaṅge khṛgalaṃ yad ābadhnanti vedhasaḥ | śravasyaṃ śuṣmaṃ kābavaṃ vadhriṃ kṛṇvantu bandhurā ||
english: In the tawny cord, the knot (khṛgala) which the wise ones bind — let those who tie knots render the renowned power of kābava castrate (vadhri).

sanskrit: yenā śravasyo caratha devā ivāsuramāyayā | śunāṃ kapir iva dūṣaṇo bandhurā kābavasya ca ||
english: By which (cord) you move about in pursuit of glory, as the gods with their asura-māyā — even as an ape (kapi) is the corrupter of dogs, so are the cord-tyers the corrupters of kābava.

sanskrit: duṣṭyai hi tvā bhantsyāmi dūṣayitvā kābavam | ud āśavo rathā iva śapathebhiḥ sariṣyatha ||
english: For ruin indeed I shall shatter you, having defiled the kābava. Like swift chariots (driven off the field), you shall career away by means of my imprecations.

sanskrit: yamasya lokād adhy ā babhūvitha pramadā martān pra yunakṣudhīraḥ | ekākinā sarathaṃ yāsi vidvān svapna mimāno asurasya yonau ||
english: From Yama's realm you have arisen, O wise one, eager to yoke mortals to intoxicated women (pramadās). You journey alone on the same chariot, O Svapna, knowing (your nature), measuring out the womb of the Asura.

sanskrit: bambas tvāgre viśvavayāpaśyat purā rātryā janitor eke ahni | tataḥ svapnedam adhy ā babhūvitha viṣvaṅvarūpam apagūhamānaḥ ||
english: Bamba first saw you everywhere, before the night, at the birth of a certain day. From that time onward you arose over this (world), O Svapna, concealing yourself in an all-pervading form.

sanskrit: bṛhan grāvāsurebhyo 'dhi devān upāvavarta mahimānam icchan | tasmai svapnāya dadhur ādhipatyaṃ trayastriṃśāsaḥ svar ānaśānāḥ ||
english: The great pressing-stone (bṛhan grāvā) turned from the Asuras toward the gods, desiring greatness. To that Svapna the thirty-three (gods), having won their way to heaven, granted lordship.

sanskrit: naitāṃ viduḥ pitaro nota devā yaiṣā jalpiś caraty antaredam | trite svapnam adadhur āptye nara ādityāso varuṇenānuśiṣṭāḥ ||
english: Neither the Pitṛs nor the gods know this babblement (jalpi) that wanders here in the midst. The Āptya-men placed Svapna in Trita Āptya; the Ādityans, instructed by Varuṇa.

sanskrit: vy asya krūram abhi yantu duṣkṛto 'svapnena sukṛtaḥ puṇyam āyuḥ | svar madasi parameṇa bandhunā tapyamānasya manaso 'dhi jajñiṣe ||
english: Let the cruel deeds of the evildoer depart from him; let the doer of good live a holy life free from evil dream. You make heaven drunk with your highest kinsman; you are born from the tormented mind of one who suffers.

sanskrit: vidma te sarvāḥ parijāḥ purastād vidma svapna yo adhipā iho te | yaśasvino no yaśaseha pāhy ārād dviṣebhir apa yāhi dūram ||
english: We know all your kindred from of old; we know, O Svapna, who here is your overlord. Protect our glory with glory here; go far away, depart to a distance from those who hate us.

sanskrit: ambāḥ sumukhāḥ sṛjata padvat sṛjata satyajñeyam | sṛjāmy ahaṃ dūtān asmai viṣāya hantave | vār ugram arasaṃ viṣam āheyam arasaṃ viṣaṃ nirviṣam ||
english: O Mothers (Ambās), fair-faced ones, release (the waters) with their creatures; release what is truly to be known. I send forth messengers to slay this poison. The potent water (vār) — the sap-drained poison, the serpent-born (āheya) — the poison sap-drained, rendered non-poisonous.

sanskrit: indram aham iha huve somapām ubhayāvinam asmai viṣāya hantave | vār ugram arasaṃ viṣam āheyam arasaṃ viṣaṃ nirviṣam ||
english: I invoke Indra here, the soma-drinker, vigorous on both sides (ubhayāvin), to slay this poison. The potent water — the sap-drained poison, the serpent-born — the poison sap-drained, rendered non-poisonous.

sanskrit: varuṇam aham iha huva ugraṃ rājanyaiḥ saha- -asmai viṣāya hantave | vār ugram arasaṃ viṣam āheyam arasaṃ viṣaṃ nirviṣam ||
english: I invoke fierce Varuṇa here together with the royal lords (rājanyās), to slay this poison. The potent water — the sap-drained poison, the serpent-born — the poison sap-drained, rendered non-poisonous.

sanskrit: aditim aham iha huve sūraputrāṃ kanīnikām asmai viṣāya hantave | vār ugram arasaṃ viṣam āheyam arasaṃ viṣaṃ nirviṣam ||
english: I invoke Aditi here, daughter of the sun (sūraputrī), the maiden (kanīnikā), to slay this poison. The potent water — the sap-drained poison, the serpent-born — the poison sap-drained, rendered non-poisonous.

sanskrit: bṛhaspatim aham iha huve yo devānāṃ purohito 'smai viṣāya hantave | vār ugram arasaṃ viṣam āheyam arasaṃ viṣaṃ nirviṣam ||
english: I invoke Bṛhaspati here, who is the purohita (domestic priest) of the gods, to slay this poison. The potent water — the sap-drained poison, the serpent-born — the poison sap-drained, rendered non-poisonous.

sanskrit: āṇāścāṇāś caṇḍāmarkā asmai viṣāya hantave | vār ugram arasaṃ viṣam āheyam arasaṃ viṣaṃ nirviṣam ||
english: The āṇas, the cāṇas, and the caṇḍāmarkas — (I invoke them) to slay this poison. The potent water — the sap-drained poison, the serpent-born — the poison sap-drained, rendered non-poisonous.

sanskrit: navānāṃ navatīnāṃ viṣasya ropuṣīṇām | sarvāsām agrabhaṃ nāma vītāpetārasaṃ viṣam ||
english: Of the nine, of the ninety, of the festering poisons — of all of them I have seized the name. The poison whose sap has utterly departed: gone, removed, sap-drained is the poison.
